summary: Frontend-only SPA navigation verification. For each converted <a>->Inertia <Link>, set window.__spa='alive' before click and verified marker survived (no full page reload) AND URL matched. Tested Admin Dashboard (4 quick-action cards + qa-disputes + Tümü in Son Siparişler), Admin Auction Show seller arrow, Admin Categories Yeni Kategori. Buyer pages (/dashboard, /favorites, /my-bids, /messages) and Alt Kategori Ekle / Seller Profile İlan Oluştur could not be exercised because the required data / render-conditions are not present in this seed (see skips). Every link actually clicked navigated via SPA (window.__spa preserved).

tests_executed.reason: Tried categories 1-10; 'Alt Kategori Ekle' button was not rendered on any (likely v-if condition or feature-flag not met in seed). Code change verified in source: Admin/Categories/Show.vue uses <Link>.
No bids present for buyer@test.com (0 elements).

Button not rendered on /u/seller. Source (Profile/Show.vue:441) gates it on v-if='pf.is_owner' AND v-if='pf.is_creator_seller'. Prop pf.is_creator_seller appears false in this seed so <Link> never mounts. Code-level change verified: uses Inertia <Link :href='pf.urls.seller_create'>.

spa_verification_method: Injected window.__spa='alive' before each click; after Inertia navigation waited 1.5–1.8s then re-read window.__spa. A full document reload would drop the property. All executed cases returned 'alive' -> confirmed SPA.
console_errors_observed: Background 403/405 errors for polling endpoints (notifications/heartbeat) unrelated to link navigation. No link click produced a full reload or JS exception.
action_items: No code fixes required for the SPA conversion — every link that could be clicked navigates via Inertia (SPA).

(Informational) To fully exercise the remaining links in future iterations, seed data would need: bids/favorites/messages for buyer@test.com, at least one admin category with sub-categories feature enabled, and Profile props pf.is_creator_seller=true for the seller.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin/Categories/Show.vue 'Alt Kategori Ekle' <Link> present in source but not reachable in current seed; verify controller returns the flag that gates its render if the UX intent is to always show it for admins.

Profile/Show.vue: 'İlan Oluştur' is doubly gated on is_owner && is_creator_seller. seller@test.com IS a verified seller with 4 active listings but is_creator_seller resolves false — worth checking the backend computation of that prop.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of executable cases (7/7 PASS, 6 skipped due to missing seed data / render conditions)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@test.com/password | Buyer: buyer@test.com/password | Seller: seller@test.com/password
context_for_next_testing_agent: SPA conversion verified for all reachable links via the window.__spa='alive' survival trick. The skipped cases are NOT bugs in the <a>→<Link> conversion; source inspection confirmed the Inertia <Link> is in place for each. Skips are caused by (a) empty buyer data (bids/favs/messages), (b) Admin/Categories/Show 'Alt Kategori Ekle' being gated and not rendering on categories 1-10, (c) Profile/Show 'İlan Oluştur' gated by pf.is_creator_seller being false in the seed. If a next iteration needs full coverage, seed data must be created first.
rca of the issue: N/A – no bugs found. All executed SPA navigations preserved the window.__spa marker, confirming Inertia <Link> is doing client-side navigation (no full document reload).
